ideas.title: Bowl Cars for Cash
ideas.hook: A giant bowling alley where the ball is a junk car with a ragdoll driver. Launch it down the lane, smash the pins (and the buildings behind them) and get paid for the wreck.
core_loop: Pick a car from the scrapyard and line up your shot
Launch it with the boost ramp and steer mid-air
Get cash for pins, damage and how far the driver flies
Upgrade launch power, armor and spin to clear bigger lanes
ideas.twist: Every lane has a bonus pin that only breaks if the driver hits it after being thrown from the car, so a perfect crash scores more than a perfect strike.
retention: Car collection with rare paint jobs
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch sits at 2.16 momentum (+0.22 this week) with Ragdoll Reality 🩸 (25.7K CCU, 13 days old) and Cat Battles 🐾 (17.7K). Physics Sim rose 0.54 to 2.03, and Vehicles is up 0.51 to 1.65 led by [🎃] Bike For Egg! (28.5K) and [🎃] Bike Universe (25.9K).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are sandboxes and car games are about driving; this turns the crash into a scored bowling shot with a clear goal and upgrade path.

ideas.title: +1 Egg Size Per Roll
ideas.hook: Roll an egg down a long course. Every roll makes it +1 bigger, and the bigger it is when you reach a nest, the rarer the pet that hatches.
core_loop: Push your egg along the stage course
Gain +1 size every roll and dodge cracks and spikes
Drop it in a nest at a checkpoint to hatch a pet
Pets boost size per roll so you reach farther stages
ideas.twist: A huge egg rolls faster but cracks on hard hits, so players choose between cashing in early at a safe nest or risking it for the giant nest at the end.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action climbed 0.53 this week to 2.22 ([🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 14.1K, [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 11.8K), and "+1 ___" titles are at 2.47 (+0.64). Eggs is steady at 1.32 across 46 new games, led by Break and Steal an Egg (133K) and [🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 (39.9K). Linear courses sit at 1.94.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games mostly break or steal eggs; here the egg itself is your growing stat and your risk, which suits short sessions.

ideas.title: Fix Satellites for Cash
ideas.hook: Work shifts as an orbit repair crew. Spacewalk to broken satellites, patch them before they drift into Earth's shadow, and get paid by the job.
core_loop: Take a repair ticket from the station board
Jetpack out and find the broken parts
Patch panels and swap parts in a quick repair minigame
Spend pay on better tools, jetpacks and a bigger crew shuttle
ideas.twist: Space junk flies through each orbit on a timer, so crews must call warnings and shield each other while one player repairs.
monetization: VIP shuttle with a faster jetpack
retention: Daily emergency repair with bonus pay
ideas.why_now: Job / shift holds 1.19 across 24 new games and edged up 0.13 this week (Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 12.5K, [UPD] Firefighting Sim 🚒 7.8K). Space rose 0.33 to 1.42 with [🚀 SPACE] roll the world 🌎 (4.4K) and [W2] +1 Slinky Escape (3.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Job games are set in kitchens, shops and towns; zero gravity and a co-op repair crew make the shift feel new.

ideas.title: Net Comets for Pets
ideas.hook: Stand on a floating asteroid and swing a giant net at the comets streaking past. Every comet you catch cracks open into a space pet for your index.
core_loop: Watch the sky for comets and time your swing
Catch comets of different colours and speeds
Crack them open at your base to hatch space pets
Use pets to unlock new orbits with rarer comets
ideas.twist: Comet showers hit the whole server at once, and rare comets split in two when netted, so the players nearby get the second half.
retention: Space pet index with secret pets
ideas.why_now: Collect / index sits at 1.96 across 34 new games ([🎃] Bike For Egg! 28.5K, [🎃] Eat Everything In A Grocery Store 8.3K), and Collect plus Hatch is the top pair (16 new games, 196K CCU). Space is up 0.33 to 1.42. Hit / swing / launch adds the swing at 2.16 (+0.22).
ideas.differentiator: Index games make you walk to things; here the rare items fly past and you need timing to catch them, with shared server events.

ideas.title: Launch Snowmen for Gems
ideas.hook: Build a snowman, then whack it off a cliff with a giant bat. The farther it flies over the frozen valley, the more gems you find where it lands.
core_loop: Roll snow to build your snowman
Swing to launch it over the valley
Collect gems and ice crystals where it lands
Gain +1 swing power every launch and upgrade your bat
ideas.twist: Snowmen get hats and carrots that change how they fly: a top hat glides, a bucket spins, a scarf catches the wind.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.16 (+0.22 this week) and the Hit plus +1 stat pair has 2 new games with 23.5K CCU ([🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 14.1K, [🎃] Throw Food For Animals). Ice / fire / elements is at 1.27 across 10 new games ([UPD] Firefighting Sim 🚒 7.8K, Free Fire Zone (Max) 4.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw stones, food or people; a snowman you build yourself gives each launch a different flight and a reason to collect parts.

ideas.title: Race Snowmobiles for Cash
ideas.hook: Race snowmobiles down frozen mountain stages while avalanches chase you. Win cash to tune your ride and unlock steeper peaks.
core_loop: Pick a stage and line up with other riders
Race down, jump crevasses and dodge the avalanche
Win cash by place and stunts
Upgrade engine, skis and boost at your cabin garage
ideas.twist: The ice cracks under heavy riders, so whoever leads changes the track for everyone behind them.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive is at 1.07 across 30 new games (Backseat Rally 18.3K, [🎃] Turbo Soccer : Beta 1.0 5.6K), Racing is at 1.5, and linear courses lead map styles at 1.94. Ice / fire / elements holds 1.27.
ideas.differentiator: New racing games stay on roads and rally tracks; a falling mountain with breakable ice adds a chase and a reason to race again.

ideas.title: Balance Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Quick party rounds where everyone carries an egg on a spoon. Race, dodge and shove through each minigame without dropping it, and the eggs that survive hatch.
core_loop: Join a lobby and get a spoon and egg
Play short rounds: races, see-saws, windy bridges
Keep your egg intact to earn a hatch at the end
Rare pets give better spoons and grip
ideas.twist: You can bump other players to make them drop their eggs, but a cracked egg drops a bonus yolk anyone can grab.
ideas.why_now: Party / minigames climbed 0.28 this week to 1.2 (🎃 [HALLOWEEN] Hunting Together RPG 4.8K, 1v1 Minigame Duel 1.9K), and Party plus Eggs is an open gap (score 4.02). Eggs holds 1.32 across 46 new games, led by Break and Steal an Egg (133K).
ideas.differentiator: Egg games are solo grinds or steal games; this turns eggs into a party round where friends can cause the drop.

ideas.title: Tryout for Powers
ideas.hook: A hero academy runs tryouts in short rounds: lift a bus, outrun a train, catch falling citizens. Top scores pick a new power first.
core_loop: Queue for a tryout lobby
Play 5 quick power tests against other recruits
Earn power points and +1 stat for every test
Unlock and level powers to rank up through the academy
ideas.twist: The power you pick changes the next tryout for everyone, so a speedster round plays differently from a strongman round.
ideas.why_now: Superheroes / powers rose 0.21 to 1.51 ([🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense 6.8K, Superhero Arena 6.7K), and Party / minigames is up 0.28 to 1.2. Party plus Superheroes is an open gap (score 2.3), and +1 stat per action sits at 2.22.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games are fights or sims; this gives heroes a minigame show where losing a round still levels you up.

ideas.title: Race Brooms for Gold
ideas.hook: Race witches' brooms through a floating castle course. Fly through rune rings, cast tricks on rivals and win gold to craft faster brooms.
core_loop: Pick your broom and join a race
Fly the course through rings and shortcuts
Cast one spell per lap to slow or swap places with rivals
Craft and collect brooms with the gold you win
ideas.twist: Some rings only open for the player in last place, so a bad start can turn into a comeback.
ideas.why_now: Fantasy / medieval rose 0.51 this week to 1.44 ([🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense 6.8K, Pixel Lineage [🎃Spear Class + Dragon Race] 4.2K, [✍️]DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA 2.3K). Race / drive holds 1.07 across 30 new games and linear courses lead at 1.94.
ideas.differentiator: Fantasy games are fights or defense; racing on brooms with comeback rings gives short, replayable rounds.

ideas.title: Drive Rovers for Moon Rocks
ideas.hook: Start with a tiny rover on the moon. Drive out to craters, haul back rare rocks and bolt new parts on until your rover is a moving base.
core_loop: Drive into craters to find rocks and parts
Haul them back before your battery runs out
Sell rocks and build rover parts in your garage
Unlock farther moons with tougher terrain
ideas.twist: Your rover is your base: other players can hitch rides, and bigger rovers carry a crew that mines while you drive.
ideas.why_now: Vehicles is up 0.51 to 1.65 ([🎃] Bike For Egg! 28.5K, [🎃] Bike Universe 25.9K) and Vehicle Sim is at 1.41 across 17 new games. Space rose 0.33 to 1.42 ([🚀 SPACE] roll the world 🌎 4.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Vehicle games give you a car to drive around a city; here the vehicle grows into your base and the moon terrain is the challenge.
